## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the guidelines in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test` passes locally.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated documentation (README, SETUP, doc comments, Swagger annotations) where user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md` (if the project maintains one) with a note under the unreleased section.
- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] I have read and agree to license my contribution under the [Elastic License 2.0](../blob/main/LICENSE).
